import unreal
pkg='/Game/SSPR_Validation'
name='RT_SSPR_Occupancy'
full=pkg+'/'+name
if unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist(full):
    print('EXISTS',full)
else:
    atools=unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()
    factory=unreal.TextureRenderTargetFactoryNew()
    a=atools.create_asset(name,pkg,unreal.TextureRenderTarget2D,factory)
    a.set_editor_property('size_x',256)
    a.set_editor_property('size_y',256)
    try:
        a.set_editor_property('render_target_format',unreal.TextureRenderTargetFormat.RTF_R16F)
    except Exception as e:
        print('fmt_warn',e)
    unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_asset(full)
    print('CREATED',full,'size',a.get_editor_property('size_x'),a.get_editor_property('size_y'))
